note: Research paraphrase for analysis; IDs are local, not official YouTube policy clause numbers.

criteria.text: Examine promotion of rapid or unusually easy wealth: identify the specific promise, required participation and stated conditions. Investment discussion or a return figure alone cannot establish deception or fraud.

Examine an alleged job, support identity or affiliation linked to requests for private information or money. Establish the claim and request from evidence; do not infer impersonation from a logo or infer theft from an input field.
Examine benefit promises used to direct viewers to another destination. Ordinary external links are insufficient; distinguish observed conditions from guessed destination behavior or unverified harm.
Examine misleading promised content only when the promise and conflicting delivered content are both observable. Sparse sampling, omitted speech or an unseen outcome do not establish a mismatch.
